name: sim_gtower_emergence_coset_decomposition
divergence_log: Emergence test: coset spaces GL/O, U/SU, O/SO appear as THIRD objects when both parent shells are simultaneously active. Neither parent shell contains the coset space. Tests that polar factor, U(1) phase, and Z2 sign are emergent DOFs.

pytorch.reason: load_bearing: torch.linalg.polar(A) extracts Q (O(3) factor) and S (Sym+(3,R) factor) from a GL matrix; verifies Q is orthogonal, S is symmetric positive-definite, S is NOT in O(3); U(1) phase extracted from det(U)/|det(U)| for U(3) vs SU(3) elements; Z2 coset label computed as torch.linalg.det sign for O(3) elements.

pyg.reason: not used in this coset emergence test; geometric topology tools deferred

z3.reason: load_bearing: z3 UNSAT proves that a positive-definite matrix with all positive eigenvalues satisfying S^T*S=I (orthogonality) forces eigenvalues = 1, so S=I; encoding that the only element in BOTH Sym+(3,R) AND O(3) is the identity -- the coset space is disjoint from O except at I.

cvc5.reason: not used in this coset emergence test; geometric topology tools deferred

sympy.reason: load_bearing: symbolic polar decomposition of 2x2 case; A=[[a,b],[c,d]], A=Q*S derived symbolically; verify S is symmetric (S^T=S); verify Q is orthogonal (Q^T*Q=I); verify S is not generally equal to I.

clifford.reason: load_bearing: in Cl(3,0) a general multivector decomposes into grade-0 (scalar scale) and grade-2 (rotation bivector rotor); the grade-0 part is the emergent coset GL/O coordinate (the scale factor); the grade-2 normalized rotor is the O(3) part; grade decomposition IS polar decomp.

geomstats.reason: load_bearing: geomstats SPDMatrices(n=3) samples from Sym+(3,R); each sample is verified NOT in O(3) (S^T*S != I in general); confirms the coset space Sym+(3,R) is geometrically distinct from both O(3) and GL(3) individually -- it is a new object from their interaction.

rustworkx.reason: load_bearing: coset emergence DAG where coset nodes {coset_GL_O, coset_U_SU, coset_O_SO} have in-degree=2 (both parent shells required); single-shell nodes have in-degree=0; verifies emergence structure: cosets are unreachable from any single parent.

xgi.reason: load_bearing: hyperedge {GL, O, coset_GL_O} of size 3 encodes that the coset is a 3-way relationship between two shells and their emergent quotient; hyperedge {U, SU, coset_U_SU} likewise; verifies size=3 for both (not pairwise, not singleton).
